children: ADT entered into an Incremental Assumption and Amendment Agreement No. 2 to add $100 million of incremental first-lien senior secured Term A loans under its existing term loan credit agreement. The new borrowings have the same terms as the existing Term A loans, bringing total Term A outstanding to approximately $520.3 million. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, enhancing ADT’s financial flexibility.
